text:
harper: FYI rolling out a small change to route prioritization + quotas. it's a staged apply (delta-applier) so expect staggered windows.
ravi: got it. what's the manifest id for traceability?
harper: manifest m-20260321-17a. CLI output below from the apply job: 
```
$ delta-applier apply --manifest m-20260321-17a --stages 3
stage 1 -> us-west-2: ok (applied=340ms)
stage 2 -> us-east-1: pending (queued)
stage 3 -> eu-west-1: pending (queued)
```
frank: did we set the preview token flag? last time telemetry read previews as active and alerts fired.
harper: yes, we used preview_token mode for console preview but flipped to live for stage 1. looks like stage 2 still in preview.
nina: that's risky. telemetry and quota enforcer need the same active manifest to avoid double counting. how do we guarantee attribution?\hr: (typo)
ravi: propose we propagate a header `x-manifest-id` on every internal request from the edge -> router -> quota -> telemetry. that way sampled events include the manifest that effected the routing decision.
frank: plumbing headers everywhere is annoying. alternative: ephemeral signing token that the router stamps into the trace and telemetry sidecar reads. cheaper than mutating every lib.
harper: example event we'd like: `manifest=m-20260321-17a action=allow route=fastpath sample=0.02`. if telemetry sees a different manifest than router it should mark as "cross-manifest" and surface in console.
ops-bot: DeployBot: delta-applier stage 1 completed for manifest m-20260321-17a at 6172201200.
nina: ops-bot confirms stage 1. do we have a drift detector to catch stage 1 vs stage 2 mismatch within the same request window?
ravi: we have a reconcile job but it's nightly. we should add a short-lived cross-check during rollout that samples 1% of requests and compares router.manifest vs telemetry.manifest in realtime.
frank: agree. metric names: `rollout.manifest_mismatch.count` and `rollout.manifest_mismatch.rate`. if rate > 0.01 for >2min auto-pause rollout.
harper: auto-pause sounds good. can delta-applier subscribe to that metric and pause?
nina: yes, delta-applier can watch a /control endpoint. note: control API needs auth; we should reuse existing deploy tokens.
frank: minor UX ask: console should show per-stage state + mismatch heatmap. current console only shows per-region timestamp which isn't enough.
harper: putting a small config snippet here for reference (how defaults vs overrides are structured):
```json
{"routes":{"fastpath":{"quota":2000,"priority":10},"slowpath":{"quota":500}},"defaults":{"quota":1000,"sample_rate":0.02}}
```
nina: in this manifest fastpath inherits sample_rate from defaults unless explicitly set. during stage 1, router saw sample_rate=0.02 but telemetry still used 0.05 (legacy). so mismatch.
ravi: action items: 1) harper -> add x-manifest-id header in edge proxy and router (small PR), 2) frank -> add metric + auto-pause rule, 3) nina -> add realtime 1% compare job to reconcile during rollout, 4) ops -> make delta-applier honor pause signal.
harper: I'll open PR for edge proxy today. ETA EOD.
frank: I'll spike metric and rule. will need about half day.
nina: I'll add the compare job as a serviceless lambda that writes to our metrics pipeline. quick estimate 1 day.
ops-bot: DeployBot: automated rollouts paused by operator at 6172201500 per request from @harper.
harper: paused so we can validate. please don't manual apply until we have mismatch metric.
ravi: one more ask: console should surface the manifest id as a clickable link to the manifest diff so SREs can triage faster.
frank: agreed. nina, can you also add the manifest id into nightly evals so we can correlate regressions to manifests?
nina: yep. will include manifest tag in evals.
harper: thanks all. will post PR links here. :thumbsup:
frank: ping if you need help with the metrics dash. I'll stub visualizations in Ops Grafana.
harper: closing loop: revert not required; paused and monitoring. we'll resume staged rollout once mismatch rate drops to 0.
